entities.name: Vaghela dynasty
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Vaghela dynasty ruled the Kingdom of Gujarat in India in the 13th century CE, with their capital at Dholka. They were the last dynasty to rule Gujarat before the Muslim conquest of the region.
